_comment_host: The MCP server has NO authentication. Use the Pi's LAN IP (not 0.0.0.0), and allow the port only from the laptop with a firewall rule (ufw allow from <laptop-ip> to any port 8765). Default if missing: 127.0.0.1 (this Pi only).
_comment_connection: Laptop-side helpers (laptop_config.py) and the stream viewer URL read these; env vars PI_HOST / PI_USER / PI_KEY / PI_PROJECT_DIR / PI_LAN_IP override them.
